Confirmed Machine 925

by Dave Shukan, with art by Mark Halpin

ANSWER: CLASSIFICATIONS / THE NOBEL PRIZE


Enumerated phrases are transposals of names of US Presidents (as they appear at www.whitehouse.gov), with a letter added. The supplementary information from 1804 changes all the presidents after John Quincy Adams yielding new transposals, and in most cases, completely new phrases with the same enumerations. (Note that the title CONFIRMED MACHINE transposes to COMMANDER IN CHIEF, with the enumeration 925, and that the flavortext contains several hints toward elections and the White House.)

Placing the extra letters in order by President yields LOOK AT INITIALS plus a bunch of initials under the original history and LOOK AT THESE PERSONS plus a different bunch of initials under the alternate history. The extra letters from the Presidents with those initials (just first and last name) spell CLASSIFICATIONS (for the original history) and THE NOBEL PRIZE (for the alternate history).
